DescriptionSummary:
In order to support  the localization of some products that have been designed by Plant A or that use PXA components, it has been agreed between Plant D and Plant A directors to reconcile the Windchill data of around 8000 parts. This will also help to secure the deployment of SAP in Plant A factory. 
This data reconciliation will result in revising thousands of parts, CAD models, and even drawings within Windchill. This is purely for technical reasons, and no product design change is permitted during this data reconciliation exercise. The release of the revised objects will be done with specific ECNs. 
But the main consequence on the business side is that a significant volume of new drawings will be released by the Engineering. It has been agreed that the drawing history block will be maintained with the following information “Revision synchronization – No design change”.
Name: Revision Synchronization - PXA Legacy
